prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one opaque square 2-by-2 raw-material atlas for native 3D inventory component models in an original nineteenth-century Argentine dark-fantasy game.
Primary request: painterly realistic worn leather and natural cord fibers. Exactly four equal square quadrants meeting at the center, edge-to-edge, no gutter, border or text. Top-left: muted dark crimson oxblood dyed leather with irregular fine natural grain and tiny worn reddish highlights, faithful to red wrapped antique grips. Top-right: dark chestnut brown leather with fine supple grain and subtle lighter abrasion, no embossing. Bottom-left: medium tawny flax/hemp cord fibers, tiny densely interlaced diagonal fibers and frayed microfuzz, warm natural brown/gold, no large rope object or black gaps. Bottom-right: darker russet braided cord fiber microtexture with closely interwoven diagonal fibers, slightly waxed natural sheen, no large braid silhouettes or gaps.
Each quadrant is a continuous homogeneous flat material swatch suitable for UV mapping onto actual volumetric coils, loops and grips. Orthographic diffuse albedo lighting, no perspective, no vignette, no objects, no cast shadows, no dimensional folds, no giant highlights, no decorative symbols or stitching, no lettering, no transparency. Fine varied surface detail, crisp but restrained; avoid flat plastic and oversized repetitive patterns. Original texture art.
